data.narrative:
Greenroom Robotics is a Series A defense and security robotics company founded by Harry Hubbert, Zac Pullen, and James Keane. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of 11 same-sector companies at Series A and adjacent Series B stages, comprising 8 private firms and 2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS). Notable private peers include Anduril Industries, Helsing, and Singularity.

Peer-median valuation methodology was the applicable triangulation approach. Across the 11-company peer universe, median valuation stands at $1.0B, with a range spanning $125M at the low end to $3.0B at the high end. Sampled Series B peers include Dream Security at $3.0B, Allen Control Systems at $2.2B, Harmattan AI at $1.4B, Code Metal at $1.2B, and Twenty at $1.0B, establishing the distribution within the comp set.

The triangulated valuation range for Greenroom Robotics is $850M to $1.1B, centered at $1.0B. This reflects the median peer valuation in the Defense & Security sector at this stage. Key uncertainties include limited data on Greenroom's specific revenue, capital efficiency, and technical differentiation relative to the peer set, as well as broader defense spending cyclicality and regulatory risk inherent to the sector. The single-method reliance also constrains confidence; revenue or profitability multiples would strengthen the analysis if available.
